correct_query: SELECT full_name FROM (SELECT LHS.staff_id AS staff_id, LHS.full_name AS full_name, RHS.org_id AS org_id, RHS.org_name AS org_name, RHS.region AS region FROM staff AS LHS INNER JOIN (SELECT LHS.org_id AS org_id, LHS.org_name AS org_name, LHS.region AS region, LHS.staff_id AS staff_id FROM (SELECT LHS.org_id AS org_id, LHS.org_name AS org_name, LHS.region AS region, RHS.staff_id AS staff_id FROM organizations AS LHS INNER JOIN memberships AS RHS ON (LHS.org_id = RHS.org_id)) AS LHS INNER JOIN (SELECT * FROM organizations WHERE (org_name = 'Research')) AS RHS ON (LHS.org_id = RHS.org_id AND LHS.org_name = RHS.org_name AND LHS.region = RHS.region)) AS RHS ON (LHS.staff_id = RHS.staff_id))

expected_semantic_errors_to_be_caught.description: Mutant flattens the self-join on organizations and drops the equality check on nullable column region (LHS.region = RHS.region), admitting rows where region IS NULL.
